dispatchInputs.reason: the Actions runs API exposes no dispatch inputs for a run: the workflow_run object has no `inputs` member (verified against GitHub API run 42340311363 on 2026-11-07) and display_title carries the workflow name, not the inputs. The dispatch selection is therefore proven from required jobs / embedded evidence where the manifest names a requiredSelection, and recorded as unverifiable otherwise -- never inferred from a title or invented

selectedTests.reason: per-gate test selection/execution counts are not exposed by the Actions API; they live in each run log, which this document does not parse. Where a gate's embedded evidence document carries a count it is recorded under gates[].tests with its source; otherwise it stays null

tier.reason: the release has no single tier: the combination journey requires tier=full and the long-lived corpus requires medium, while other gates have none. Per-gate tiers are recorded under gates[].tier only where an embedded evidence document names them; a single release-wide value would be invented
